newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to make law to cover bourse depository.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to make law to cover bourse depository.

text.p: The Pakistani cabinet agreed on Monday to make a law to give legal cover to a planned central depository system for handling stocks traded on the country's bourses, a government statement said.

It said the proposed legislation will provide "a comprehensive legal framework for the effective functioning of the system" being established by a company set up by Pakisatan's three stock exchanges in collaboration with some foreign and local banking and financial institutions.
It gave no details of the legislation, which must be passed by the two houses of parliament.

The new system, being established by the Central Depository Company of Pakistan Ltd, will replace the present manual system of physical handling and settlement of shares at the exchanges, the system said.
"The securities industry in Pakistan will thus be transformed from the manual and laborious set-up to a modern and efficient scripless computer-aided system," it said.
